unnamed_1: Season 37 is now the true newest season of the Amazing Race, and we are finally back to true TAR. I don't even consider this to be a "COVID" Season. I think that this Season is indicative of the Amazing Race making itself bigger and better, espeically with twists on every leg - not that I think that will be true for every forthcoming Season.
- This was the first Season with a historic high of 14 teams.
- This was the first Season since Season 33 with a true non-elimination leg, and the first since Season 4 with a non-elim leg and no penalty. It was also the latest ever on Leg 9.
- There were twists on every leg of the race for the first time. There was a Scramble for the third time on the final leg.
- This was the second season in a row with a new country traveled to - Bulgaria.
- This Season had 90 challenges, which is the most since Season 8 and tied for the 5th-most all time with Season 3.
